about: Each of the 48 fixes reverted at the tip bae28a1b11f4 (its changes outside fs/ext4/*-test.c reversed), then kunit.py run --arch=um --kunitconfig=fs/ext4. Derived from the raw result files in fixes/run4-results.tar.gz.
